content: The moment someone opens the form they get a copy of their own, saved into {{inProgress}} as they type — nothing is lost if they close the tab, and nothing counts as an answer until they submit. Anyone you invite as {{formFiller}} sees only their own copy, never anyone else's.

comment.text: Description text within an onboarding tour step explaining the auto-save feature of forms; includes variables for a status name (`{{inProgress}}`) and a user role (`{{formFiller}}`).
